name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz Yilmaz's passion for aerodynamics began with a childhood fascination with aircraft and Formula 1. He pursued a degree in Aerospace Engineering, quickly specializing in computational fluid dynamics and its application to motorsport. After several years honing his skills at smaller racing outfits, Deniz's innovative approach to downforce generation caught the attention of CLRT by Almeras. He believes in a data-driven, iterative design process, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's aerodynamically possible within the regulations. Deniz is known for his ability to translate complex simulations into tangible performance gains on the track.

His leadership style is collaborative, fostering a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement within his aero team. He is a strong advocate for investing in cutting-edge simulation tools and nurturing young talent. While demanding, Deniz is respected for his unwavering commitment to excellence and his willingness to mentor aspiring engineers. He's determined to make CLRT by Almeras a force to be reckoned with in aero development.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Deniz is of average height, with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and equations.
Insists on having a pot of Turkish coffee brewed fresh every afternoon.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
